text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... I can't find it~.
Any luck on your end, Bourbon-san?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Target lost again.
Continuing search...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ah! There she is, Bourbon-san!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
! Next time for sure...!
Mayano-san will reach your goal—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Eye copy!
Maya's gonna continue her mission, so you go on ahead, Bourbon-san!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rattle-clatter...)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I spotted Rice-san entering this classroom.
She was—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, just as Bourbon-san came in,
she went home at the exact same time...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...! Once again...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Bourbon-san!?
Why are you looking so exhausted...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I kept... missing Rice-san...
and only now did we finally meet up...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh...... so that means...
You've been looking for Rice all this time...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I'm so sorry! It's all Rice's fault...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No, in the process, the precision of my sharp turns has improved.
It's likely thanks to chasing after Rice-san all day today.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh, thanks to me...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Plus, Happy White Day.
Here is a return gift for the chocolates you gave me before.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Mission "Payback" in progress.
Taking today into account, will you accept this "token of gratitude" from me to you?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
! Bourbon-san...!
Y-Yeah! Of course!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, Bourbon-san.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Brian-san, I finally found you~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Geez, today's White Day, you know! Maya gave you chocolates on Valentine's, remember?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...You mean that bizarrely sweet stuff?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehhー!? Isn't it just the right amount of sweet~?
It's chocolate from *that* "Chocolat's Time," you know~?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Not that!
What about Maya's White Day gift!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Ah.
I see now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped. I'll give you
what you want.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Really!? In that case,
grown-up makeup would be great♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What you desire is a race.
One that sets the soul ablaze... Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Are you ready to lose?
You copy?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Heh.
Come on, let's go.
